kv22.4:1.3: atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammasamavaṇaṃ, dhammasākacchā, paripucchā, sīlasamādānaṃ, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogo’ti.
kv22.4:1.5: natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammasavaṇaṃ …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogo’ti.
kv22.4:1.7: hañci natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammasavaṇaṃ …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogo, no ca vata re vattabbe”atthi
kv22.4:2.4: parato ca ghoso yoniso ca manasikāro’ti.
kv22.4:2.7: parato ca ghoso yoniso ca manasikāro, no ca vata re vattabbe
